body.summary: Added src/shared/locks/lock-manager.ts: the lock block layout (header capacities, name table, per-name lock/pending-exclusive/version/mutex words, holder and pending tables), createLockBlock, LockManager.resolveName, the four error classes, argument validation and installLockManager/getLockManager. Name slots are claimed by CAS from free to -(claimer threadId + 1), filled and published READY last; a resolver never passes a slot another thread is still claiming, so one name maps to one slot, and reclaim can reset a claim left by a dead thread.
